quote.113-233: add filoviruses, a family of viruses that includes the Ebola virus, to the list of tropical diseases under the priority review voucher program, which awards vouchers to sponsors of human drug applications
quote.113-98: Amends the Public Health Service Act to extend and reauthorize appropriations through FY2018 for payments to children's hospitals associated with operating approved graduate medical residency training programs.
quote.114-146: add Zika virus disease to the list of tropical diseases under the priority review voucher program, which awards a voucher to the sponsor of a new drug or biological product
quote.113-291: Authorizes the Navy to enter into a contract during FY2015 for the procurement of one San Antonio class amphibious ship using incremental funding.

114-255.note: The House agreed to the Senate amendment with an amendment (the final text) by recorded vote, roll 592 on 2016-11-30; the Senate then agreed. (The House's 2015-01-07 voice vote was on the bill's original text.)

114-187.note: The House passed H.R. 5278 (PROMESA) by roll 288 on 2016-06-09; under H.Res. 770 the Senate bill S. 2328 was then considered passed with the House-passed text, without a separate vote.

114-190.note: The House agreed to the Senate amendments with amendments pursuant to H.Res. 818, which was adopted without a recorded vote. The House's 2015-02-13 roll 82 on H.R. 636 was on the bill's original small-business expensing text, not the FAA extension, so it is not used.
